note: Select at most `budget` labelled rows for a fixed kNN. Each class lies on a thin curved manifold. The pool is polluted by mislabels, off-manifold rows and redundant dense knots. Unlike the uniform-margin parent problem, different stretches do not have the same classification margin: some class bands pass much closer together than others. A good subset must stay clean, preserve end-to-end support, and spend extra resolution where competing class manifolds are locally close.
